## Subsetting

```{r}
nh |> select(Age, BMI)
nh |> select(-SurveyYr)
nh |> select(starts_with("BP"))
nh |> select(ID, starts_with("BP"))
nh |> select(ID, starts_with("BP"), BMI)
```


```{r}
nh |> filter(Age >= 18)
nh |> filter(Age >= 18, Sex == "female")
nh |> filter(Smoke100 == "Yes" | Diabetes == "Yes")
nh |> filter(SurveyYr %in% c("2009_10", "2011_12"))
nh |> filter(SurveyYr %in% c("2011_12"))
nh |> filter(SurveyYr =="2011_12")
```

nrow(nh)

2751 + 6883

## Handling duplicates

```{r}
nrow(nh)
head(nh)

n_distinct(nh$ID)
length(unique(nh$ID))

nh |> count(ID) |> filter(n > 1)

nh |> count(ID)

library("janitor")
nh |> get_dupes(ID)




nh_u <- nh |> 
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

nh_u


```


## Sorting 

```{r}
nh_u |> 
  arrange(Sex, desc(Age))

hist(nh_u$Age, breaks = 20)
```

```{r}
nh_u |> 
  relocate(BMI, .after = ID)

sort(names(nh_u))

nh_u[, sort(names(nh_u))] |> 
  select(ID, Age, Sex, everything())

nh_u
```

## Transforming

```{r}
nh_u <- nh_u |> 
  rename(sex = Sex, survey_year = SurveyYr)  
```



```{r}
nh_u <- nh_u |> 
  mutate(
    bmi_class = case_when(
      BMI < 18.5 ~ "underweight",
      BMI < 25 ~"normal",
      BMI < 30 ~"overweight",
      BMI >= 30 ~"obese"
    ),
    age_group = cut(Age, breaks = c(0,18,40, 60, Inf), right =FALSE)
  )

head(nh_u)


count(nh_u, bmi_class)
table(nh_u$bmi_class)
```

```{r}
552/nrow(nh_u)
552/(nrow(nh_u) - sum(is.na(nh_u$Diabetes)))
```








## Group-by


### Here's our answer!!!!


```{r}
nh_u |> 
  group_by(bmi_class) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_diabetic = mean(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    nr_diabetic = sum(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

What about doing it for the EARLY entries, and for the LATE entries, separately?

```{r}
# one way to do that
nh_u |> 
  filter(survey_year == "2011_12") |> 
  group_by(bmi_class) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_diabetic = mean(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    nr_diabetic = sum(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  )


# another way to do that
library("ggplot2")

nh_u |> 
  group_by(bmi_class, survey_year) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_diabetic = mean(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    nr_diabetic = sum(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
nh_u |> 
  group_by(bmi_class, survey_year) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_diabetic = mean(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    nr_diabetic = sum(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = bmi_class, y = prop_diabetic, col = survey_year)) + geom_point()+ theme_bw()

```





## Combining

```{r}
ghb_f <- haven::read_xpt("datasets/GHB_F.XPT")    # 2009-10
ghb_g <- haven::read_xpt("datasets/GHB_G.XPT")    # 2011-12

glimpse(ghb_f)
glimpse(ghb_g)

ghb <- bind_rows(ghb_f, ghb_g)

ghb


nh_ghb <- nh_u |> 
  left_join(ghb, by = join_by(ID == SEQN))

head(nh_ghb)

nh_ghb |>
  group_by(Diabetes) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean_hba1c = mean(LBXGH, na.rm = TRUE))

library("ggplot2")
ggplot(nh_ghb,
       aes(x = Diabetes, y = LBXGH)) + geom_jitter()

```

# Chapter 6 

## Data visualization!

```{r}
library("dplyr")
library("tidyr")
library("gapminder")
library("ggplot2")
library("ggforce")

# checkpoint from chapter 4, with the factor order from chapter 5
nh <- readRDS("datasets/nhanes_ghb.RDS") |>
  mutate(bmi_class = factor(bmi_class,
                            levels = c("underweight", "normal", "overweight", "obese")))

# nh <- nh_ghb

nh
```


```{r}
ggplot(nh)

ggplot(nh, aes(x = Age, y = BMI))

ggplot(nh, aes(x = Age, y = BMI)) + geom_point()
ggplot(nh, aes(x = Age, y = BMI)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.3)
ggplot(nh, aes(x = Age, y = BMI, col = Smoke100)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.3)

colnames(nh)

ggplot(nh, aes(x = bmi_class, y = LBXGH)) + geom_point()
ggplot(nh, aes(x = bmi_class, y = LBXGH)) + geom_jitter()
ggplot(nh, aes(x = bmi_class, y = LBXGH)) + geom_boxplot()
ggplot(nh, aes(x = bmi_class, y = LBXGH)) + ggforce::geom_sina()
ggplot(nh, aes(x = bmi_class, y = LBXGH)) + geom_violin()
ggplot(nh, aes(x = bmi_class, y = LBXGH)) + ggforce::geom_sina(alpha = 0.3)

```

```{r}
ggplot(nh, aes(x = BMI)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) + theme_void()

ggplot(nh, aes(x = BMI)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2)            
```



```{r}
ggplot(nh, aes(x = Age, y = BMI, colour = sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3)

ggplot(nh, aes(x = Age, y = BMI)) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3)
```


```{r}
library("ggforce")

nh |>
  filter(Age >= 18) |>
  drop_na(BPSys1, Smoke100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Smoke100, y = BPSys1, col = sex)) +
  geom_sina() +
  facet_wrap(~ age_group)
```


```{r}
nh |>
  group_by(bmi_class) |>
  summarise(prevalence = mean(Diabetes == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bmi_class, y = prevalence)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "BMI class", y = "Diabetes prevalence")
```


```{r}
nh |>
  drop_na(bmi_class, Diabetes, age_group) |>
  group_by(age_group, bmi_class) |>
  summarise(prevalence = mean(Diabetes == "Yes"), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bmi_class, y = prevalence, fill = age_group)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge")

nh |>
  drop_na(bmi_class, Diabetes, age_group) |>
  group_by(age_group, bmi_class) |>
  summarise(prevalence = mean(Diabetes == "Yes"), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age_group, y = prevalence, fill = bmi_class)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge")
```
